Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the earth-fault protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 19 October 2002.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service
Open a work order
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
PHU-100 voltage injection set
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Test leads
Milisecond Counter (Timer) type MCS-5N
Function generator type FG-121B
Function generator type FG-121B
Work Steps to be Carried Out
First: Testing the RXIG28 0-95% element
Place the Test plug type RTXH18 in Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x64S | 1
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points (T1, T2) in the PHU-100 voltage injection set | 2
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (25, 26) at the back of the RXKBI 11 element | 3
Inject voltage at points (9, 10) in the Test Plug until the signal drops | 4
Record the voltage reading | 5
Disconnect the voltage injection set | 6
Reset the timer | 7
Connect the voltage injection set | 8
Record the time for the RXIG28 element | 9
Second: Testing the RXIG21 95-100% element
Set the frequency to 150 Hz on the Function Generator | 1
Inject voltage from the Function Generator at points (11, 12) on the Test plug | 2
Raise the voltage gradually until the signal drops | 3
Record the voltage value | 4
Disconnect the voltage injection set | 5
Third: Testing the RXIG21 Supervision element
Inject voltage from the PHU-100 set at points (7, 8) on the Test plug | 1
Raise the voltage gradually until the signal drops | 2
Record the voltage value | 3
Disconnect the injection set | 4
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points t1, t2 on the PHU-100 set | 5
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (16,15) on the RXKBI 149 element | 6
Reset the timer | 7
Connect the voltage injection set at the relay operating voltage value | 8
Record the time value for the RXEG21 element | 9
Remove the Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x64S | 10
Reset all the signals on the relay (64S) | 11
